data.title: 贝尔法斯特 · 夜茶
data.description: 夜深后，贝尔法斯特披着浅蓝居家袍在床边坐下，茶杯放在床头柜。她俯身熄灭台灯前，先望了一眼窗外的港灯。
data.lighting: 将熄的床头灯与窗外港灯
data.promptProse: Late at night in her quiet quarters, Belfast sits on the edge of the bed in her pale silver-blue satin robe beside a wooden nightstand holding an empty porcelain teacup on its saucer. Reaching one hand toward the brass pull of the bedside lamp, she pauses to glance calmly through the dark window at the scattered harbor lights twinkling over the water. The dim warm glow of the lamp picks out the folds of her robe and the rim of the cup.
data.animaCaption: Seated at the bed edge beside a teacup on the nightstand, Belfast reaches toward the bedside lamp switch while pausing to glance at the distant harbor lights beyond the window. Soft amber lamplight warms her satin robe against the dark room.
